title: The operator's answer is persisted through a typed stage-document writer, wording kept apart from interpretation
statement: When the operator answers during a stage, the answer is written into that stage's document - for Stage 1, the intake document - through a registered typed stage-document writer, never by editing the file directly. What is written keeps the operator's own wording verbatim and separate from the orchestrator's interpretation of it, and the writer refuses a write outside the content root's stage documents.
notes: Created 2026-09-13 (D15) from the persistence clause ACC-0068 used to carry. It belongs to TSK-0049's continuous intake capture rather than to TSK-0048's first turn. No typed stage-document writer exists today: `lib/tools/` writes typed artifacts under `data/` only, and nothing writes `stages/*.md`. TSK-0049 has to add one. ACC-0069's adaptive second question is unchanged.
